note: Generated by scripts/measure-art-bounds.mjs. bounds = [x0,y0,x1,y1] of the art as fractions of the 2:3 frame, measured against a flat viewer surround (surround = its colour) or, for a render painted on a scene, against that scene (plate = which one, from scripts/measure-art-plate-bounds.py); assets without bounds fill their frame. motion = fraction of pixels that change across 24 sampled clip frames; 0 means a frozen clip.
